releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.58 returns Home and Files to the previous light design while keeping the current app functions. Home keeps live Celsius weather and the same Scan, Search, New Note and Save Link actions. Files keeps the current on-device file summary, filename/type search, scan, categories and file actions, but returns to the light layout used before the glass redesign. Notes, Library, Settings, sharing, indexing, categories and update behavior are unchanged.
